entities.name: Lewis B. Schwellenbach
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lewis Baxter Schwellenbach was a United States senator from Washington, a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Washington and the 5th U.S. secretary of labor.
